name: Overall Class Rank Across Arts and Commerce
releaseNote: For Std 11 and 12 result printouts, Class Rank is calculated across all active students in the same standard, combining Arts and Commerce. Rank is based only on percentage; equal percentages receive the same rank. Rank is no longer limited to the top 10.
notes: Display/calculation update only. No student data, marks, exam records, subject-specific grades, Supabase schema, or database records changed.
